entities.summary: Leme is a municipality in the state of São Paulo in Brazil. The population is 104,346 in an area of 403 km2 (156 sq mi). At the 2000 census, it had 80,757 residents, 40,830 of whom are men and 39,927 women. 65,885 residents are 10 years old or older, and of these, 59,991, or 91.1%, are literate. Leme officially became a town on August 29, 1895. The municipality is formed by the main district and also includes the rural neighborhoods Taquari, Taquari Ponte and Caju.
